release_notes: Improved skill level progression with stricter full-character-set coverage handling.
Added a separate full charset coverage metric for level calculation without changing raw skill WPM.
Full charset coverage now requires high-quality rounds before characters count toward level progression.
Improved handling of character-set scope so punctuation practice no longer unlocks level coverage too easily.
Clarified skill panel labels by distinguishing data coverage from full charset coverage.
Rebuilt skill snapshot history support for the updated level progression model.
Fixed and refined skill rating display details.
General bug fixes and stability improvements.
Improved overall application behaviour and user experience.
